title: Formula evaluator with error positions
acceptance: Numbers incl. exponents, precedence and associativity, right-associative ^ with unary minus below it, floored modulo, whitespace, variables/constants/override, functions; ExprError is a ValueError; exact positions for end-of-input, unexpected tokens, implicit multiplication, bad characters, '5.' and '2e', syntax errors winning over evaluation errors; positions for unknown names/functions, calling a variable, arity (checked before arguments), function failure, division and modulo by zero, invalid powers, left-to-right error order.
difficulty_rationale: A full tokenizer, precedence-climbing parser and evaluator with an unusual unary/power rule and precise error-position rules for both phases; a quick attempt usually gets several positions or the unary/power interaction wrong.
